utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: Good morning to everyone in and around the courtroom. Madam Registrar, could you call the case, please.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. This is the case IT-04-75-T, the Prosecutor versus Goran Hadzic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: Thank you. May we have the appearances, please, starting with the Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: MR. STRINGER
utterances.text: Good morning, Mr. President, Your Honours. For the Prosecution, Douglas Stringer, Matthew Olmsted, Case Manager Thomas Laugel, and legal intern Morvarid Bagheri.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: Thank you. And for the Defence, Mr. Zivanovic.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZIVANOVIC
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. For the Defence of Goran Hadzic, Zoran Zivanovic and Christopher Gosnell. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: Thank you. Before we call the next witness in, there's a short oral ruling about the Prosecution motion for extension of time to submit additional documentation demonstrating that Witnesses GH-079 and GH-142 are unavailable pursuant to Rule 92 quater filed on the 11th of June, 2013. The Defence objected to the motion in its response filed on the same day, arguing that the Prosecution has not shown that it acted with due diligence. Also, on the 11th of June, Prosecution indicated in court that it has now received the requested material in relation to Witness GH-079. The Prosecution submitted this material for filing on the same day, in accordance with the original deadline. The Chamber considers that extending the deadline related to GH-142 as requested will not unduly prejudice the Defence. The motion is hereby granted. For the next witness, we go into closed session, please. And the witness may be brought in.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Your Honours, we're back in open session.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Thursday, the 13th day of June, 2013, at 9.00 a.m. 20 21 22 23 24 25
